mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pool_card (id, pool_id, gpu_brand, gpu_model, node_name, serial_no, spec_id, slots, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{poolId}, #{gpuBrand}, #{gpuModel}, #{nodeName}, #{serialNo}, #{specId}, #{slots}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pool_card WHERE pool_id = #{poolId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(slots), 0) FROM pool_card WHERE pool_id = #{poolId} AND status = 'active'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(slots), 0) FROM pool_card WHERE pool_id = #{poolId} AND spec_id = #{specId} AND status = 'active'
SELECT DISTINCT node_name FROM pool_card WHERE pool_id = #{poolId} AND spec_id = #{specId} AND status = 'active' AND node_name IS NOT NULL
